column1: # Lane social-feed, wave 29. Partition src/components/social/feed/**.
# THREE COMMITS, each carrying its own oracle and each value proved red by a
# mutation applied ALONE from a pristine copy and restored by copying that copy
# back - never by a reverse string replace, because a token in the code also
# appears in the comment explaining it. That trap fired once this pass: the
# desktop-gutter mutation came back AMBIGUOUS because `xl:px-8` occurs in the
# block comment above the class it names.
#   43d2754fd  the upload card at its three drawn sizes (15 tests, 14 mutations,
#              all RED)
#   75ae86a07  the Discover page gutter (3 tests, 6 mutations, all RED)
#   e9cd8c767  the three 1440 dropdowns the width table was guessing at
#              (3 new fixtures + 3 tests, 5 mutations, proved with a NEGATIVE
#              CONTROL rather than a green - see below)
# Suite over src/components/social/feed at 16:05 on 2026-09-06: 19 files /
# 304 tests green, tsc clean. A green is a moment, not a state.
# THE NEGATIVE CONTROL, because a green that cannot go red is not evidence.
# Three cells of FEED_MENU_WIDTH had no frame behind them - the 250 shared by
# post select, posts and creators at 1440 was carried from a different pair of
# menus, with only a monotonicity bound under it, which any value above the
# tablet 220 satisfies. Each was mutated 250 -> 300 and the suite run TWICE:
# once against the new oracle and once against the oracle exactly as it stood
# at HEAD. RED here, GREEN there, on all three. Two rule-position mutations
# came back RED against BOTH, which is what says the control measures coverage
# rather than an old file that always passes.
# THE INSTRUMENT NOTE. `get_metadata` was not used for any value here. Every
# number came off the Plugin API, the only reader that enumerates a node's
# fills, its NODE opacity and its text segments separately. That distinction
# decided one of the upload card's fixes: the meta heading has a flat #FFFFFF
# fill AND a node opacity of 0.64, and either number alone is the wrong answer.
# WHAT THIS LANE FOUND THAT IS NOT A PIXEL. Four of the five feed dropdowns are
# exported from the barrel and imported by NOBODY - `buildPostSelectMenu`,
# `buildCreatorsMenu`, `buildTimeframeMenu` and `buildContentFilterMenu` have
# zero callers in `src/` outside `feed/index.ts`. Only `buildPostsMenu` is
# mounted, at PostCard's tridots panel (`PostCard.tsx:306`). So twelve of the
# fifteen dropdown frames measure clean on every axis and still are not `done`:
# a menu nothing opens is not shipped, and marking it done would put the
# catalog's dominant defect class behind a green row.
# key

The row heights follow `12 + max(16, leading)` at every width, which is why the two glyphless menus draw 26 at 375 where the iconed three draw 28, and why all five draw one 30 at 1440 - desktop leading 18 is taller than the 16px glyph, so the glyph stops deciding. The catalog's dominant defect class is code that exists and is never called, and a `done` row here would hide exactly that. It becomes `done` the day a caller renders `SocialMenu` with these items; nothing in `feedMenus.ts` has to change for that. This row is the 1440 draw.
